title: Jeffersonville Golf Club
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Jeffersonville Golf Club is an 18-Hole, par 70 public courses, owned and operated by West Norriton Township. Opened in 1931, Jeffersonville was designed by legendary architect Donald J. Ross. West Norriton Township purchased the golf course in 1972.
